subject: Minor code quality improvements (#621)
reason: The change is a pure refactor with no behavior change in the module: it removes an unused local variable and renames a lambda parameter in QueryCommand::Execute (src/commands/commands.cc), and makes kDefaultMinStemSize constexpr in ft_create_parser.h — the constant is only ever read (ft_create_parser.cc:599), never written, so constexpr cannot change behavior. The remaining edits are to Python integration tests (keyword arguments, a shared verify_modules_loaded helper, graceful server.exit() in cleanup) and a README license-text update, none of which are compiled into the module.
